repos.name: ledgerline
repos.description: Double-entry ledger service in Go with PostgreSQL: idempotent transfers, event sourcing, gRPC API
repos.readme:
# ledgerline
A double-entry ledger service written in Go. Ledgerline records money movements as immutable journal entries in PostgreSQL and exposes a gRPC and REST API.

## Features
- Idempotent transfers with idempotency keys and optimistic locking
- Event sourcing with a transactional outbox that publishes to Kafka
- Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing out of the box
- Runs locally with Docker Compose; Helm chart for Kubernetes

## Benchmarks
On a single 4-vCPU node with PostgreSQL 16, ledgerline sustains 4,800 transfers/sec at p99 latency under 35 ms.
Balance queries stay under 3 ms thanks to materialized running balances.

## Quick start
docker compose up
go install github.com/jordanlee-example/ledgerline/cmd/ledgerline@latest

repos.description: Redis-backed rate limiting middleware for FastAPI (sliding window + token bucket)
repos.readme:
# fastapi-ratelimit
Redis-backed rate limiting middleware for FastAPI. Supports sliding window and token bucket algorithms.
[![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/fastapi-ratelimit-kit)](https://pypi.org/project/fastapi-ratelimit-kit/)

pip install fastapi-ratelimit-kit

## Why
Adds under 0.4 ms overhead per request in our benchmarks and handles 20k req/s against a single Redis instance.
Fully typed, async, tested with pytest at 96% coverage. CI runs on GitHub Actions.

Teams using it cut review turnaround from 2 days to 4 hours.
